name: ikhlas.com Half Marathon 2026
short_description: ikhlas.com Half Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Dataran Kemerdekaan Shah Alam in Shah Alam, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The ikhlas.com Half Marathon 2026 is the first edition of this race, organised by ikhlas.com at Dataran Kemerdekaan Shah Alam, Selangor, on 6 December 2026. It offers 21 km and 10 km races with open, veteran and international categories, plus a 5 km fun run, and the event page lists a start time of 4:30 am.

faqs.question: When and where is the ikhlas.com Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: It is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at Dataran Kemerdekaan Shah Alam, with the event page listing 4:30 am. This is the first edition, run under the theme "Honouring the Body: Our Foundation in Purpose & Fitness".

faqs.question: What are the categories and fees?
faqs.answer: The 21 km costs RM88 and has open (18-39), veteran (40 and above) and international categories for men and women. The 10 km costs RM68 and the 5 km fun run RM55.
